explanation: This function is vulnerable to OS command injection (CWE-78) because user_input is concatenated directly into os.system('ls ' + user_input). Crafted input with shell operators could execute arbitrary OS commands. The repair quotes user_input with shlex.quote() while retaining os.system(), which mitigates injection on POSIX shells but remains unsafe on non-POSIX shells such as Windows and still allows option injection into ls.
